name: Marsena
title: Advisor to King Ahasuerus
summary: Marsena was one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who had direct access to King Ahasuerus (Xerxes I). He was among the king's closest advisors who were consulted when Queen Vashti refused to obey the king's command. These seven wise men knew the law and justice and were highly trusted in the Persian empire.
relatedPersons: Shethar, one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who stood closest to King Ahasuerus

keyEvents.title: One of the king's seven princes
keyEvents.description: Marsena is mentioned as one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who saw the king's face and held the highest seats in the kingdom.

keyEvents.title: The King's Counsel Regarding Vashti
keyEvents.description: When Queen Vashti refused to come to the king's feast, King Ahasuerus consulted his seven wise men, including Marsena, about what the law said regarding her disobedience.

keyEvents.title: Vashti Refuses the King's Command
keyEvents.description: During a great feast, the drunken King Ahasuerus ordered Queen Vashti to appear before the guests, but she refused, leading the king to seek advice from his princes.

keyEvents.title: Memukan's Proposal Is Adopted
keyEvents.description: After the consultation, Memukan, one of the seven princes to whom Marsena belonged, proposed that Vashti should lose her title as queen, and this was approved by the king and the princes.
